podcast.title: Pre-Release Touring and Bootlegs
podcast.body: The band had been touring with their material for a considerable period before the album's official release, with live recordings circulating unofficially due to strong public interest. "Llevan ya bastante tiempo girando con este material, el material de ellos en directo está circulando pirata desde hace mucho tiempo, porque a mucha gente le está gustando."

podcast.title: Rage Against the Machine Iteration
podcast.body: Prophets of Rage is considered another iteration of Rage Against the Machine, featuring its instrumental members alongside Chuck D of Public Enemy and B-Real of Cypress Hill, effectively replacing Zack de la Rocha. "And then there's Prophets of Rage, of course, which could be looked at as yet another iteration of Rage Against the Machine with Chuck D and B. Real and place him Zach."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Groups That Changed Their Front-Person and Survived

xref.title: Chuck D Joins Prophets of Rage
xref.body: Chuck D of Public Enemy joined the instrumental members of Rage Against the Machine along with B-Real of Cypress Hill to form Prophets of Rage. "Interesting that be real is now in profits of Rage with the other Rage guys in Chuck D. of Public Enemy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Extensive Opening Slots
xref.body: Ho99o9 has opened for a diverse range of prominent bands, including Avenged Sevenfold, Korn, Alice in Chains, Three Days Grace, and Prophets of Rage. "Horror has opened up for a Venge 7-fold, corn, Alice and Chains, three days grace, profits of rage and more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Family Connection to Adam Jones
xref.body: Tom Morello, guitarist for Rage Against the Machine, Audioslave, and Prophets of Rage, has a family connection to Adam Jones of Tool. Morello's mother was Adam Jones's home-room teacher. "The mother of Tom Morello, guitarist for rage against the machine, audio slave and profits of rage, was the home-room teacher of Adam Jones, guitarist with tool."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
